objective: Derive and execute the largest defensible EARNINGS_EPS economic backtest from the frozen full 1355 official-domain expansion without post-hoc selection.

primary_universe.inclusion_policy: Include every group from the frozen full expansion that satisfies pre-specified eligibility; no performance-conditioned filtering is allowed.
primary_universe.date_policy: Use the earliest through latest eligible events available in the frozen manifests; do not select a date window based on returns or hit rate.

eligibility_rules: The group must come from the frozen full 1355 official-domain expansion.
The event must have a deterministic ticker or ticker candidate that maps to a tradable common equity or ADR when prices are requested.
The event must have a deterministic event reference date before any return calculation.
Official-domain identity evidence must be preserved; failures remain in the audit trail and cannot be silently dropped except by pre-specified eligibility failure code.
Prediction-market signal must be point-in-time prior to the trading cutoff; no settlement or realized outcome can define the signal.
Historical prices for the security and benchmark must exist for the entry and exit sessions.
If any required input is missing, the row is marked ineligible with a deterministic failure reason instead of being manually rescued.

economic_rule_family.primary_rule: M2 probability sensor translated into equal-notional long/short only through pre-specified signal thresholds inherited from the prior economic protocol when available; otherwise report no promoted strategy and use eligibility/backtest as expansion evidence only.
economic_rule_family.fallback_rule: C0_NO_TRADE remains the default economic champion unless the expanded gate beats it under the pre-specified decision rule.
economic_rule_family.side_policy: Long and short rules must be symmetric or explicitly justified before returns are read.
economic_rule_family.position_sizing: Equal-notional per eligible trade; no leverage optimization; no retrospective portfolio weighting.
economic_rule_family.entry_exit: Calendar/session deterministic around the event reference date; if exact session alignment is unavailable, mark the row ineligible rather than moving the window after observing returns.

costs_and_benchmark.benchmark: SPY matched over the same entry/exit sessions unless a pre-specified ticker-specific benchmark is available before execution; SPY is default to preserve continuity with the prior economic audit.
costs_and_benchmark.slippage_policy: No additional slippage optimization; sensitivity may be reported only if pre-registered and non-promotional.

promotion_requires: positive primary mean market-adjusted net return per opportunity
confidence interval lower bound above zero or pre-specified one-sided test passing after multiplicity correction
statistical_decision_rule.negative_or_null_policy: Negative, null or inconclusive results must remain reportable and cannot be rescued by changing universe, horizon, threshold, benchmark, costs or metric after returns are read.

execution_next_step: Create/freeze executor; then create a separate execution authorization that explicitly opens only the reads needed to determine N_final_backtestable and compute the frozen economic metrics.
